title: 5.1.24 Falling Block: Example
description: A dynamic block falls under gravity and lands on a static floor. Read the example, then experiment.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: Click Run. The block falls and the floor catches it.
hints: Static sprites don't move; they push back on dynamic ones.

steps.title: Turn gravity off
hints: Gravity units are roughly pixels per second².

steps.title: Make the floor dynamic
steps.instructions: Remove the `'static'` argument from the ground sprite. Both pieces fall now: that's why the floor is static.
hints: new Sprite(x, y, w, h) defaults to dynamic. Add 'static' to anchor it.

steps.title: Add a second falling block
steps.instructions: Declare another sprite and color it differently. Watch them stack.
hints: Give them different x positions so they don't spawn on top of each other.
